entities.summary: Joni Turunen is a Finnish boxer. He competed in the men's featherweight event at the 2000 Summer Olympics. Two time medalist in world boxing championships, Berlin 1995 bronze medal in flyweight, and Belfast 2001 bronze medal in featherweight. Last Finnish male boxer in olympic games.
